evidence: Touches fuzz harnesses (process_message/process_messages) and unit test utilities in src/test/util/
rationale: Expands fuzz harness coverage to BIP 157 compact block filter P2P messages, reaching previously ignored net_processing code paths and immediately uncovering a UBSan integer overflow bug (author provides reproduction linking to #36321). It also prevents a use-after-free in ChainTestingSetup teardown.
